items.en: I get excited about learning new things in class.
items.zh_draft: 在课堂上学到新东西让我感到兴奋。

items.en: I feel like I belong at my school.
items.zh_draft: 我觉得自己是学校的一分子。

items.en: I feel like the things I do at school are important.
items.zh_draft: 我觉得自己在学校做的事情很重要。
我觉得自己是一名表现出色的学生。

items.en: I am really interested in the things I am doing at school.
items.zh_draft: 我对自己在学校做的事情很感兴趣。

items.en: I can really be myself at school.
items.zh_draft: 在学校，我能够真实地做自己。

items.en: I think school matters and should be taken seriously.
items.zh_draft: 我认为学校生活很重要，应该认真对待。

items.en: I do good work at school.
items.zh_draft: 我在学校的学习任务做得好。

items.en: I enjoy working on class projects and assignments.
items.zh_draft: 我喜欢完成课堂项目和作业。

items.en: I feel like people at my school care about me.
items.zh_draft: 我觉得学校里的人关心我。

items.en: I feel it is important to do well in my classes.
items.zh_draft: 我觉得在课堂学习中表现好很重要。

items.en: I do well on my class assignments.
items.zh_draft: 我的课堂作业完成得好。

items.en: I feel happy when I am working and learning at school.
items.zh_draft: 在学校做事和学习时，我感到快乐。

items.en: I am treated with respect at my school.
I believe the things I learn at school will help me in my life.
items.zh_draft: 我相信在学校学到的东西会对我的生活有帮助。

items.en: I get good grades in my classes.

instructions: 下面的问题涉及你在学校的想法、感受和行为。请阅读每句话，选择最符合你过去一个月情况的答案。
